newsitem.title: USA: Manhattan Bagel in agreement with AAFES.
newsitem.headline: Manhattan Bagel in agreement with AAFES.

text.p: Manhattan Bagel Co Inc said Monday that it signed a licensing agreement that awards the Army Air Force Exchange Service (AAFES) rights to operate Manhattan Bagel shops on selected U.S. military bases throughout the world.
The company said in a release that AAFES will at first open Manhattan Bagel units on two U.S. bases during the first quarter of 1997 and that it was evaluating several locations presented by AAFES.
AAFES is the headquarters for the Army and Air Force Post and Base Exchanges, located at about 142 military installations worldwide, the release said.
The exchanges serve over seven million customers from the military community and AAFES had total sales for 1995 of $6.7 billion, with $508 million derived from food service operations, it added.
